_meta.description: meta-autocode build tasks — autocode implements meta-autocode to beat Codex (61.5%) on harness benchmarks

tasks.description: Implement the PIV (Plan-Implement-Validate) loop core — EnhancedPIVStrategy, PIVPlan, PIVResult, SessionScores. All 9 pytest tests must pass. This is Phase 1 of meta-autocode, the harness designed to beat Codex (61.5% baseline).

Implement ProgressiveContextLoader in src/meta_autocode/context.py — relevance-scored file loading that puts test files first. 65% of harness failures are context/env setup issues (arxiv 2508.18993). All 8 pytest tests must pass.

Implement BenchmarkMaxxer in src/meta_autocode/maxxing.py — multi-variant strategy that runs N approaches per task and picks the best. At 3 variants, P(at least one resolves) = 1-(1-0.615)^3 = 94.3%, demolishing Codex. All 9 pytest tests must pass.

Implement MetaAutocodeRunner in src/meta_autocode/runner.py — wires PIV + ProgressiveContextLoader + BenchmarkMaxxer into a single pipeline. This completes meta-autocode. Theoretical solve rate: 1-(1-0.615)^3 = 94.3% > Codex 61.5%. All 9 pytest tests must pass.

Implement EnvironmentSetup in src/meta_autocode/environment.py — detects language/build system, generates setup commands. Addresses 65% of harness failures (arxiv 2508.18993). Target: beat Codex xhigh 81.5% on harness-bench v2. All 9 pytest tests must pass.

Fix src/color_encoder.py to handle both legacy pydantic.v1.color.Color (.as_hex()) and modern pydantic_extra_types.color.Color (.as_named()). Inspired by fastapi/fastapi PR#15101 (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/6 tests currently fail with AttributeError.

Fix src/paginator.py: paginate() uses page*per_page instead of (page-1)*per_page, returning wrong slice for all pages. Inspired by memos/gitea pagination (harness-bench v2 pattern). 5/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/flow_runner.py: execute_flow() calls async run_step() without asyncio.run(), returning coroutine objects instead of dict results. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow (harness-bench v2 pattern). 5/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/incident_tracker.py: ongoing down-incident at end-of-stream is silently dropped because the post-loop EOF check is missing. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/api_client.py: urllib.parse.urljoin replaces the base path segment when endpoint is relative and base has no trailing slash. Inspired by axios/axios URL construction (harness-bench v2 pattern). 4/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/semver.py: is_newer() and latest() compare version strings lexicographically — '1.10.0' < '1.9.0' as strings. Inspired by vitejs/vite version checks (harness-bench v2 pattern). 5/8 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: vitejs/vite semver string vs numeric comparison

tasks.description: Fix src/file_detector.py: detect_language() uses split('.')[1] instead of split('.')[-1], returning wrong extension for multi-dot filenames. Inspired by sharkdp/bat (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: sharkdp/bat file extension split index bug

tasks.description: Fix src/commit_stats.py: count_commits_by_author() uses = 1 instead of += 1, resetting every author's count to 1 per commit. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea contributor stats (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: go-gitea/gitea commit counter assignment vs increment

tasks.description: Fix src/display.py: truncate() appends suffix after cutting to max_len, producing max_len+len(suffix) chars. Inspired by jesseduffield/lazygit terminal rendering (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/config_merger.py: merge_config() uses shallow dict unpacking ({**base, **override}), dropping sibling keys inside nested sections. Inspired by vitejs/vite config resolution (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: vitejs/vite config deep merge shallow vs recursive

tasks.description: Fix src/tag_parser.py: extract_tags() returns raw word[1:] including trailing punctuation — '#bug.' yields 'bug.' instead of 'bug'. Inspired by usememos/memos hashtag parsing (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/flow_sorter.py: topological_sort() seeds BFS queue from nodes[0] only — graphs with multiple source nodes silently drop entire branches. Fix: seed from all zero-in-degree nodes. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow DAG execution (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: langflow-ai/langflow DAG topological sort multiple sources

tasks.description: Fix src/status_page.py: sort_monitor_groups() uses case-sensitive sort — 'Backend' sorts before 'api' because uppercase ASCII < lowercase ASCII. Fix: use key=lambda g: g['name'].lower(). Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma status page (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/http_client.py: request() iterates interceptors in insertion order (FIFO) but axios contract requires LIFO — last added runs first. Fix: use reversed(self._interceptors). Inspired by axios/axios interceptor dispatch (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: axios/axios request interceptor LIFO dispatch order

tasks.description: Fix src/response_serializer.py: serialize_response() with exclude_none=True only strips top-level None fields — nested dicts are not recursed into. Fix: recurse into nested dicts. Inspired by fastapi/fastapi pydantic response_model_exclude_none (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: fastapi/fastapi pydantic exclude_none shallow vs recursive

tasks.description: Fix src/display_width.py: display_width() uses len(text), counting \t as 1 col instead of expanding to next tab stop. Fix: return len(text.expandtabs(tab_width)). Inspired by sharkdp/bat terminal rendering (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: sharkdp/bat tab stop display width len vs expandtabs

tasks.description: Fix src/wiki_name.py: sanitize_wiki_name() uses str.replace(' ', '_'), producing double underscores for consecutive spaces and leading underscores for leading spaces. Fix: re.sub(r'\s+', '_', name.strip()). Inspired by go-gitea/gitea wiki (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/config_merger.py: merge_vite_config() replaces arrays (plugins, conditions, etc.) with the override array instead of concatenating them. Fix: add isinstance(list) check and use base[key] + override[key]. Inspired by vitejs/vite mergeConfig (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/heartbeat.py: compute_status() checks response_code == 200 instead of the full 2xx range 200 <= response_code < 300. Fix: use range comparison. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma HTTP monitor (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/memo_search.py: search_memo() uses case-sensitive 'in' operator. Fix: query.lower() in content.lower(). Inspired by usememos/memos search (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/release_sorter.py: sort_releases() uses lexicographic sort so v1.9.0 comes before v1.10.0. Fix: parse semver components and sort numerically. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea release listing (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/type_validator.py: can_connect() uses exact equality so 'Any' wildcard connections are rejected. Fix: check for 'Any' on either side before comparing. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow node connection validation (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/line_range.py: filter_lines() uses >= in the guard so single-line ranges (start==end) return [] instead of one element. Fix: change >= to >. Inspired by sharkdp/bat --line-range feature (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/branch_validator.py: is_valid_branch_name() rejects any dot ('.' in name) but git only forbids double-dots ('..') in ref names. Fix: change the check to '..' in name. Inspired by jesseduffield/lazygit branch validation (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/path_param.py: parse_path_param() uses str.isdigit() which rejects negative integers like '-1'. Fix: use try/except int() instead. Inspired by fastapi/fastapi path parameter type coercion (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: fastapi/fastapi path parameter negative integer coercion

tasks.description: Fix src/header_merger.py: merge_request_headers() returns config_headers directly, discarding defaults. Fix: return {**defaults, **config_headers}. Inspired by axios/axios default header merging (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/label_manager.py: add_labels_to_issue() concatenates lists without deduplication, allowing duplicate label IDs. Fix: deduplicate while preserving order. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea issue label management (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/memo_visibility.py: filter_by_visibility() uses strict equality so 'public' doesn't match memos stored as 'PUBLIC'. Fix: normalize both sides with .upper(). Inspired by usememos/memos visibility filter API (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/response_time.py: calculate_avg_response_time() includes zero (failed) entries, dragging the average down. Fix: filter out zeros before averaging. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma monitor response time display (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: louislam/uptime-kuma avg response time zero exclusion

tasks.description: Fix src/cert_checker.py: cert_status() warns only at <=7 days, missing 8-30 day window. Fix: change threshold to <=30. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma SSL monitoring (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: louislam/uptime-kuma SSL cert expiry warning threshold

tasks.description: Fix src/path_guard.py: is_safe_path() uses substring '..' check, blocking valid filenames like 'file..txt'. Fix: check path components. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea file path security (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/bool_coercer.py: coerce_to_bool() uses bool(value) which makes bool('false')=True (non-empty string). Fix: explicitly handle string representations. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow type coercion (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/tag_extractor.py: extract_tags_from_memo() only processes first line, missing tags on subsequent lines. Fix: process all words in content. Inspired by usememos/memos hashtag extraction (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/date_formatter.py: format_commit_date() uses plain f-string, so month 3 becomes '3' not '03'. Fix: use :02d format specifier. Inspired by jesseduffield/lazygit date display (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/url_builder.py: build_url() strips trailing slash from base but not leading slash from path, causing '//path' double slashes. Fix: also lstrip('/') from path. Inspired by axios/axios baseURL concatenation (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: axios/axios baseURL path concatenation double slash

tasks.description: Fix src/theme_sorter.py: list_themes() uses sorted() without a key, so uppercase names sort before lowercase. Fix: sorted(themes, key=str.lower). Inspired by sharkdp/bat --list-themes (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/word_count.py: count_words() uses split(' ') which only handles single spaces — tabs and consecutive spaces cause wrong counts. Fix: use split() with no argument. Inspired by usememos/memos memo word count (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/input_validator.py: validate_numeric_input() uses >= max_val, rejecting the boundary value itself. Fix: change to > max_val. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow component input validation (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: langflow-ai/langflow numeric input max inclusive boundary

tasks.description: Fix src/paginator.py: paginate() sets total=len(page_items) (current page count) instead of len(items) (full collection). Fix: use len(items). Inspired by go-gitea/gitea REST API pagination (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: go-gitea/gitea REST API pagination total count

tasks.description: Fix src/retry_policy.py: should_retry() only retries on status 500, missing 502/503/504. Fix: check 500 <= status_code < 600. Inspired by axios/axios retry adapter (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/css_module.py: generate_css_module_class() hashes only class_name, causing same-named classes in different files to collide. Fix: include file_path in the hash. Inspired by vitejs/vite CSS module scoping (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: vitejs/vite CSS module class name hash scoping

tasks.description: Fix src/query_list.py: parse_list_query_param() uses dict assignment, keeping only the last value for repeated params like ?tag=a&tag=b. Fix: collect into a list with append. Inspired by fastapi/fastapi List query parameter (harness-bench v2 pattern). 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: fastapi/fastapi repeated query parameter list collection

tasks.description: Fix src/fork_counter.py: fork_repository() uses a no-op assignment (repo['fork_count'] = repo['fork_count']) instead of incrementing. Fix: repo['fork_count'] += 1. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea fork event handling. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/tab_expander.py: expand_tabs() ignores tab_width and always replaces tabs with 4 spaces. Fix: use ' ' * tab_width. Inspired by sharkdp/bat --tabs flag. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/env_filter.py: get_client_env_vars() returns all env vars instead of filtering to VITE_ prefix. Fix: {k: v for k, v in env_vars.items() if k.startswith('VITE_')}. Inspired by vitejs/vite client env exposure. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: vitejs/vite VITE_ prefix env var filtering

tasks.description: Fix src/content_truncator.py: truncate_content() cuts content at max_length but omits the trailing '...'. Fix: return content[:max_length] + '...'. Inspired by usememos/memos list view. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/response_serializer.py: serialize_response() ignores exclude_none flag and always returns all fields including None values. Fix: when exclude_none=True, filter out keys with None value. Inspired by fastapi/fastapi response_model_exclude_none. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/diff_counter.py: count_diff_lines() counts '+++' and '---' file header lines as added/removed code lines. Fix: skip lines starting with '+++' or '---' before checking for '+'/'-'. Inspired by jesseduffield/lazygit diff stats. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: jesseduffield/lazygit unified diff header line exclusion

tasks.description: Fix src/heartbeat_validator.py: validate_heartbeat_interval() uses > 0 instead of >= 20, allowing intervals between 1-19 seconds that would over-poll targets. Fix: return interval_seconds >= 20. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/header_checker.py: has_header() uses case-sensitive dict lookup. HTTP headers are case-insensitive per RFC 7230. Fix: name.lower() in {k.lower() for k in headers}. Inspired by axios/axios header handling. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/plugin_sorter.py: sort_plugins() returns plugins in registration order, ignoring enforce property. Fix: sort by {'pre':0, None:1, 'post':2}. Inspired by vitejs/vite plugin pipeline. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/port_validator.py: validate_output_ports() checks for missing names but ignores duplicate port names. Fix: track seen names with a set and append error on collision. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow component validation. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: langflow-ai/langflow duplicate output port name detection

tasks.description: Fix src/range_validator.py: validate_int_range() ignores ge/le bounds and always returns value. Fix: raise ValueError when value < ge or value > le. Inspired by fastapi/fastapi parameter constraints. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: fastapi/fastapi path parameter ge/le constraint enforcement

tasks.description: Fix src/webhook_verifier.py: verify_webhook_signature() uses hashlib.sha1 instead of hashlib.sha256. Fix: replace sha1 with sha256 in the hmac.new() call. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea webhook security. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/timeout_resolver.py: resolve_timeout() returns raw timeout even when <= 0. Fix: return DEFAULT_TIMEOUT (30) when timeout <= 0. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow flow runner. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: langflow-ai/langflow flow execution timeout default fallback

tasks.description: Fix src/comment_counter.py: count_issue_comments() counts all comments including threaded replies. Fix: sum(1 for c in comments if c.get('parent_id') is None). Inspired by go-gitea/gitea issue API. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: go-gitea/gitea issue top-level comment count excluding replies

tasks.description: Fix src/search_highlighter.py: highlight_matches() uses str.replace() which is case-sensitive. Fix: use re.sub with re.IGNORECASE flag. Inspired by usememos/memos search. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/rate_limiter.py: is_rate_limited() uses strict > (allows exactly limit requests). Fix: use >= to block at the limit. Inspired by fastapi/fastapi middleware rate limiting. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: fastapi/fastapi rate limiter inclusive boundary enforcement

tasks.description: Fix src/commit_checker.py: check_commit_message() warns only for first lines > 72 chars, but conventional limit is 50. Fix: change threshold from 72 to 50. Inspired by jesseduffield/lazygit commit linting. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: jesseduffield/lazygit commit subject line length warning at 50 chars

tasks.description: Fix src/tag_validator.py: is_valid_release_tag() accepts any non-empty string. Fix: validate with regex ^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea release tag creation. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: go-gitea/gitea release tag semver format validation

tasks.description: Fix src/status_checker.py: is_status_ok() checks for exactly 200 instead of the 2xx range. Fix: return 200 <= status_code < 300. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma monitor checks. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: louislam/uptime-kuma HTTP success status 2xx range check

tasks.description:
Fix src/line_normalizer.py: normalize_line_endings() only replaces 
, leaving standalone  (old Mac line endings) unchanged. Fix: chain .replace('
','
').replace('','
'). Inspired by sharkdp/bat. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: sharkdp/bat CR and CRLF line ending normalization to LF

tasks.description: Fix src/timeout_merger.py: resolve_request_timeout() always returns instance_timeout, ignoring request_timeout. Fix: return request_timeout if request_timeout is not None else instance_timeout. Inspired by axios/axios. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: axios/axios per-request timeout override of instance default

tasks.description: Fix src/memo_creator.py: create_memo() defaults visibility to 'public' instead of 'private'. Fix: change 'public' to 'private' in the fallback. Inspired by usememos/memos privacy defaults. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: usememos/memos default memo visibility set to private

tasks.description: Fix src/pr_issue_finder.py: find_closing_issues() uses case-sensitive 'Closes' regex. Fix: add re.IGNORECASE flag to match 'closes', 'CLOSES', etc. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea auto-close on PR merge. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: go-gitea/gitea case-insensitive PR closing keyword detection

tasks.description: Fix src/error_detector.py: is_error_response() only returns True for >= 500, missing 4xx client errors. Fix: return not (200 <= status_code < 300). Inspired by axios/axios. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: axios/axios non-2xx HTTP response error detection including 4xx

tasks.description: Fix src/component_validator.py: validate_component_metadata() only validates 'name', ignoring empty/missing 'description'. Fix: also append error when description is falsy. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: langflow-ai/langflow component name and description required validation

tasks.description: Fix src/color_validator.py: is_valid_label_color() accepts any non-empty string. Fix: validate with regex ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea label colors. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: go-gitea/gitea label color #RRGGBB hex format validation

tasks.description: Fix src/memo_filter.py: filter_memos() returns all memos including archived, ignoring include_archived=False. Fix: filter out memos where archived=True when include_archived is False. Inspired by usememos/memos. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: usememos/memos archived memo exclusion from list results

tasks.description: Fix src/param_encoder.py: encode_params() joins list values with commas (ids=1,2,3) instead of repeating keys (ids=1&ids=2&ids=3). Fix: iterate list values and append separate key=value pairs. Inspired by axios/axios. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: axios/axios repeated key URL parameter serialization for lists

tasks.description: Fix src/scope_checker.py: has_required_scopes() uses intersection (any overlap) instead of subset (all required). Fix: set(required_scopes).issubset(set(token_scopes)). Inspired by fastapi/fastapi OAuth2 scopes. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: fastapi/fastapi OAuth2 security scope subset containment check

tasks.description: Fix src/line_formatter.py: format_line_number() always uses width=4 regardless of total_lines. Fix: width = len(str(total_lines)). Inspired by sharkdp/bat display. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: sharkdp/bat dynamic line number padding width based on file size

tasks.description: Fix src/permission_checker.py: user_has_permission() uses == (exact match) instead of >= (hierarchical). Fix: return user_level >= required_level. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea team permissions. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: go-gitea/gitea team permission level hierarchy >= comparison

tasks.description: Fix src/pin_toggler.py: toggle_pin() always sets pinned=True, making it impossible to unpin. Fix: memo['pinned'] = not memo.get('pinned', False). Inspired by usememos/memos. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: usememos/memos memo pin status boolean toggle

tasks.description: Fix src/monitor_updater.py: update_monitor_status() only updates last_check when monitor was previously down. Fix: always set monitor['last_check'] = current_time. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/line_numberer.py: number_lines() uses enumerate(lines) starting at 0 instead of the start parameter. Fix: enumerate(lines, start=start). Inspired by sharkdp/bat line number rendering. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/repo_star_counter.py: toggle_star() increments repo['stars'] on both star and unstar. Fix: decrement by 1 on unstar. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea star toggling. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/arg_builder.py: build_git_args() joins args with ',' instead of ' '. Fix: use ' '.join(). Inspired by jesseduffield/lazygit command building. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/tag_extractor.py: extract_tags() regex pattern [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ doesn't match hyphens in tag names like #open-source. Fix: use [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+. Inspired by usememos/memos. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/config_getter.py: get_nested() uses .get() + None check which conflates a None value with a missing key, returning default for both. Fix: check 'key not in current' before accessing. Inspired by vitejs/vite config resolution. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/request_merger.py: merge_request_headers() always sets Content-Type to 'application/json', overwriting the caller's value. Fix: use setdefault() instead. Inspired by axios/axios. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/branch_checker.py: is_valid_branch_name() missing double-dot (..) check. Fix: add r'\.\.'  to invalid_patterns. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/issue_linker.py: extract_issue_refs() only matches 'Fixes' keyword, missing 'Closes', 'Resolves', 'Fix'. Fix: expand pattern alternation. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/flow_validator.py: validate_flow_inputs() uses len(nodes) without checking nodes is a list. Fix: add isinstance(nodes, list) check. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/uptime_calculator.py: calculate_uptime_percentage() uses len(checks) as the numerator, always returning 100%. Fix: count only checks with status=='up'. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/path_joiner.py: join_url_path() doesn't insert / when path lacks a leading slash. Fix: use '/' + path.lstrip('/'). Inspired by axios/axios. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: axios/axios URL path joining slash insertion

tasks.description: Fix src/session_expiry.py: is_session_expired() compares elapsed seconds against ttl_minutes directly. Fix: multiply ttl_minutes by 60. Inspired by louislam/uptime-kuma. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: uptime-kuma session expiry TTL unit seconds vs minutes

tasks.description: Fix src/pr_merger.py: can_merge_pr() checks 'approved' key instead of 'review_approved'. Fix: change key name. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/release_namer.py: generate_release_name() uses dash (-) instead of dot (.) separator in version tag. Fix: f'v{major}.{minor}.{patch}'. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/memo_visibility.py: can_view_memo() incorrectly allows 'public' role to view 'protected' memos. Fix: remove 'public' from the allowed roles tuple. Inspired by usememos/memos. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/label_matcher.py: find_matching_labels() uses case-sensitive comparison. Fix: lowercase both sides. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/retry_calculator.py: get_retry_delay() uses base_delay + 2^attempt instead of base_delay * 2^attempt. Fix: change + to *. Inspired by axios/axios. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/file_sizer.py: format_file_size() uses 1000-based boundaries instead of 1024-based binary units. Fix: replace 1000 with 1024. Inspired by sharkdp/bat. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: bat/bat file size binary vs decimal units

tasks.description: Fix src/config_merger.py: merge_configs() assigns result = base directly, mutating caller's config. Fix: use copy.deepcopy(base). Inspired by vitejs/vite. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: vite/vite config deep merge no mutation

tasks.description: Fix src/priority_queue.py: get_highest_priority() uses min() instead of max(). Fix: change min to max. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/token_counter.py: count_tokens() returns len(text) (char count) instead of len(text.split()) (word count). Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: langflow token count characters vs words

tasks.description: Fix src/webhook_dispatcher.py: should_dispatch_event() has extra 'or bool(subscribed_events)' making any event dispatch if subscriptions exist. Fix: remove it. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: gitea webhook event dispatch extra or clause

tasks.description: Fix src/response_builder.py: build_api_response() sets success only for status==200. Fix: 200 <= status_code < 300. Inspired by fastapi/fastapi. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/commit_linter.py: lint_commit_message() has inverted condition — errors on valid types. Fix: change 'in' to 'not in'. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: gitea commit type check inverted condition

tasks.description: Fix src/watch_counter.py: update_watch_count() returns len but doesn't store in repo['watch_count']. Fix: add repo['watch_count'] = len(watchers). Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/diff_renderer.py: render_diff_line() returns context lines without space prefix. Fix: return ' ' + line for context. Inspired by sharkdp/bat. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: bat diff context line space prefix

tasks.description: Fix src/notification_filter.py: filter_notifications() with unread_only=True returns READ items. Fix: change filter to 'not n.get(read)'. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/file_watcher.py: get_watched_extensions() doesn't strip leading dot from extension names. Fix: use lstrip('.'). Inspired by vitejs/vite. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: vite file watcher extension dot normalization

tasks.description: Fix src/slug_generator.py: generate_slug() uses underscore as word separator. Fix: use hyphen (-) for URL slugs. Inspired by usememos/memos. 3/7 tests currently fail.

Fix src/lazy_loader.py: get_or_load() stores to cache but calls loader_fn() again anyway. Fix: return _cache[key] instead of result of second call. Inspired by langflow-ai/langflow. 3/7 tests currently fail.

extra.harnessbench_pattern: langflow lazy loader cache always calls loader

tasks.description: Fix src/page_calculator.py: get_page_count() uses floor division (//) losing partial last page. Fix: use math.ceil or (total+size-1)//size. Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/port_allocator.py: is_port_available() is inverted, returns True when port IS used. Fix: change 'in' to 'not in'. Inspired by vitejs/vite. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/markdown_stripper.py: strip_markdown() removes bold/italic but not backtick code spans. Fix: add re.sub for backticks. Inspired by usememos/memos. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/event_deduplicator.py: deduplicate_events() uses only type as key, ignoring resource_id. Fix: key = (type, resource_id). Inspired by go-gitea/gitea. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix src/format_checker.py: is_valid_email() regex requires exactly 2-char TLD. Fix: use {2,} for TLD. Inspired by fastapi/fastapi. 3/7 tests currently fail.
Fix off-by-one in batch slice: items[i:i+batch_size-1] drops last item per batch. Fix: items[i:i+batch_size].
Fix clone URL builder: HTTPS branch returns SSH URL format (git@host:owner/repo.git). Fix: https://host/owner/repo.git.
Fix interceptor chain: applies interceptors in reversed() order instead of insertion order.
Fix semver comparator: compares version parts as strings, so '10' < '9'. Fix: int() conversion.
Fix rate limiter: uses < instead of <= so the max_requests-th allowed request is blocked.
Fix cache invalidator: reassigns keys_to_remove on each tag (only last tag's keys removed). Fix: extend instead of assign.
Fix syntax highlighter: uses exclusive range_end (line < range_end) instead of inclusive (line <= range_end), missing last line.
Fix event scheduler: uses >= instead of <= so future events are returned instead of past ones.
Fix plugin registry: case-sensitive lookup fails when name casing differs from registration. Fix: normalize to lowercase.
Fix path normalizer: backslashes not converted to forward slashes before collapsing. Fix: path.replace('\\', '/').
Fix permission checker: uses any() instead of all(), granting access with only one required permission.
Fix response timer: start - end instead of end - start returns negative elapsed time.
Fix connection pool: returns connections without checking healthy flag. Fix: skip unhealthy connections.
Fix template renderer: uses single-brace substitution but templates use {{key}} double-brace format.
Fix flow node validator: checks in-edges for source nodes instead of out-edges, producing wrong validity results.
Fix JSON serializer: exclude_none only strips top-level None values, not nested ones. Fix: recursive cleanup.
Fix git log parser: split('|', 1) merges author and message into one field. Fix: split('|', 2).
Fix status aggregator: counts 'down' checks instead of 'up' checks for uptime percentage.
Fix URL builder: uses HTML entity & instead of & to join query params.
Fix diff calculator: counts all new_lines as additions instead of only lines not in old_lines.
Fix tag sorter: count-based sort is ascending instead of descending, showing least-used tags first.
Fix search indexer: index[word] = [doc_id] overwrites on each doc, losing all but the last. Fix: append.
Fix task priority selector: max() returns highest priority_number (lowest priority). Fix: use min().
Fix config validator: 'if not value' treats 0, False, [] as missing. Fix: 'if value is None'.
Fix alert throttler: compares elapsed seconds against cooldown_minutes directly (60x mismatch). Fix: multiply by 60.
Fix repo forker: fork_count is decremented (-1) instead of incremented (+1) on each fork.
Fix string truncator: slices to max_length then appends ellipsis, exceeding max_length. Fix: reserve space for ellipsis.
Fix import resolver: checks 'path in module_name' (backwards). Fix: 'module_name in path'.
Fix paginator: offset=page*page_size skips first page. Fix: offset=(page-1)*page_size.
Fix list rotation: rotates left (items[1:]+items[:1]) instead of right (items[-1:]+items[:-1]).
Fix tag merger: returns intersection (&) instead of union (|), losing unique tags from each set.
Fix HTTP retry: retries on 200 (success) instead of 5xx (server error). Fix: 500 <= status_code < 600.
Fix severity filter: uses > instead of >= so incidents exactly at threshold are silently excluded. Fix: change > to >=.
Fix memo tag search: case-sensitive comparison misses tags with different casing. Fix: lowercase both query and stored tags before comparing.
Fix file extension extraction: returns full filename for extension-less files instead of empty string. Fix: check rsplit produced 2 parts before returning index 1.
Fix query string parser: split('=') without maxsplit crashes when value contains '='. Fix: split('=', 1) to split only on first equals sign.
Fix event log: returns first N events instead of last N (most recent). Fix: use events[-n:] instead of events[:n].
Fix title case: str.title() treats apostrophes as word boundaries, uppercasing after them. Fix: use ' '.join(w.capitalize() for w in text.split()).
Fix git tag ref detection: typo 'refs/tag/' (missing 's') never matches valid tag refs. Fix: use 'refs/tags/' prefix.
Fix HTTP method validation: case-sensitive check rejects lowercase/mixed-case methods. Fix: method.upper() before set lookup.
Fix percentage calculation: integer division (//) truncates fractional results. Fix: use float division (/) instead.
Fix vowel counter: uses text[1:] skipping the first character. Words starting with a vowel are miscounted. Fix: iterate over text (not text[1:]).
Fix relative path detection: only checks './' prefix, misses '../' parent-relative paths. Fix: also check startswith('../').
Fix date range overlap: checks 'range1 contains range2' instead of any overlap. Fix: return start1 <= end2 and start2 <= end1.
Fix palindrome check: case-sensitive comparison treats 'Racecar' as non-palindrome. Fix: compare cleaned.lower() == cleaned.lower()[::-1].
Fix mode finder: uses min() instead of max() — returns least frequent item instead of most frequent. Fix: change min to max.
Fix digit sum for negative numbers: str(-5)='-5' causes int('-') ValueError. Fix: use str(abs(n)) to strip sign.
Fix all_unique(): loop returns False on duplicate but falls off end (returns None) for unique lists. Fix: add 'return True' after the loop.
Fix top contributors: ascending sort picks least active authors. Fix: add reverse=True to sorted() call.
Fix Cookie header builder: uses ',' separator instead of '; '. Fix: change join separator to '; '.
Fix value clamping: returns wrong bound when out of range (max when below min, min when above max). Fix: swap the return values.
Fix deduplicate(): seen set is never updated (missing seen.add), so duplicates are never filtered. Fix: add seen.add(item) after appending.
Fix edit access check: uses 'and' instead of 'or' — requires user to be BOTH owner AND admin. Fix: change 'and' to 'or'.
Fix URL slug generator: replaces spaces with '_' instead of '-'. Fix: change replace(' ', '_') to replace(' ', '-').
Fix pre-release detection: checks '+' (build metadata) instead of '-' (pre-release marker). Fix: return '-' in version.
Fix leading zero strip: lstrip('0') returns '' for all-zero strings. Fix: return s.lstrip('0') or '0' to keep at least one digit.
Fix camel_to_snake(): PascalCase gets leading underscore. Fix: add .lstrip('_') to remove the spurious leading underscore.
Fix is_printable_ascii(): missing lower-bound check allows control chars (tab, newline, null). Fix: change to 32 <= ord(c) <= 126.
Fix count_words(): splits on literal ' ' — fails for empty string, consecutive spaces, and tabs. Fix: use text.split() (no args).
Fix is_secure_url(): startswith('https') accepts 'httpsexample.com'. Fix: use startswith('https://').
Fix format_commit(): message whitespace not stripped — leading/trailing spaces and newlines leak into output. Fix: message.strip().
Fix uptime_percentage(): case-sensitive 'UP' comparison misses 'up'/'Up'. Fix: use c.upper() == 'UP'.
Fix max_line_length(): lines[:-1] skips the last line — wrong result when last line is longest. Fix: iterate lines without slice.
Fix count_public_memos(): returns len(memos) instead of filtering by visibility='PUBLIC'. Fix: sum with get('visibility') check.
Fix is_js_file(): only checks .js — misses .mjs and .cjs. Fix: endswith(('.js', '.mjs', '.cjs')).
Fix short_hash(): returns 6 chars instead of conventional 7. Fix: commit_hash[:7].
Fix is_in_range(): uses < instead of <= for upper bound — excludes max_val. Fix: min_val <= value <= max_val.
Fix parse_content_type(): lstrip() leaves trailing space before ';'. Fix: strip().
Fix is_success(): checks == 200 instead of 2xx range — rejects 201, 204, 206. Fix: 200 <= status_code < 300.
Fix is_valid_repo_name(): checks space and dot but misses slash. Fix: add '/' not in name.
Fix is_response_ok(): uses <= instead of < — accepts exact-threshold as OK. Fix: response_ms < max_ms.
Fix count_lines(): count('\n')+1 adds phantom line for empty/trailing-newline input. Fix: len(text.splitlines()).
Fix is_pinned(): reads 'pinned' key instead of 'is_pinned'. Fix: memo.get('is_pinned', False).
Fix remove_extension(): split('.')[0] removes at first dot — multi-dot names truncated. Fix: rsplit('.', 1)[0].
Fix branch_from_ref(): split('/')[-1] only returns last segment — nested branches truncated. Fix: split('refs/heads/', 1)[-1].
Fix left_pad(): rjust(width) ignores char argument — always pads with space. Fix: rjust(width, char).
Fix is_valid_param_name(): isidentifier() accepts Python keywords. Fix: add 'not keyword.iskeyword(name)'.
Fix has_valid_timeout(): 'timeout' in config accepts 0 and negatives. Fix: add config['timeout'] > 0.
Fix is_admin(): checks role == 'admin' only — misses 'owner'. Fix: role in ('admin', 'owner').
Fix is_healthy(): threshold is 99 instead of 99.5 — accepts 99.0-99.4% as healthy. Fix: uptime_percent >= 99.5.
Fix should_highlight(): case-sensitive extension lookup misses .PY, .JS, .CSS. Fix: lowercase extension before lookup.
Fix get_latest_memo(): ascending sort returns oldest. Fix: reverse=True or use max().
Fix is_bare_import(): only checks './' — misses '../' relative paths. Fix: not path.startswith('.').
Fix is_conventional_commit(): type lookup is case-sensitive — 'Feat', 'FIX' rejected. Fix: type_part.lower() in _TYPES.
Fix have_overlapping_keys(): uses == instead of intersection — misses partial overlap. Fix: bool(set(d1)&set(d2)).
Fix validate_limit(): max is 1000 instead of 100 — accepts oversized pages. Fix: 1 <= limit <= 100.
Fix build_url(): base+path creates double slash when base has trailing '/'. Fix: rstrip('/') + '/' + lstrip('/').
Fix can_fork(): requires write/admin — fork only needs read. Fix: include 'read' in allowed permissions.
Fix is_stale_alert(): uses > not >= — exact-threshold age not flagged. Fix: age_seconds >= max_age.
Fix page_count(): integer division drops partial last page. Fix: math.ceil(total_items / page_size).
Fix truncate_content(): appends '...' after full slice — result is max_len+3. Fix: slice to max_len-3 before appending.
Fix get_env_var(): ignores the default argument — always returns None on missing key. Fix: config.get(key, default).
Fix is_main_branch(): startswith('main') matches 'mainline', 'main-branch'. Fix: branch_name == 'main'.
Fix merge_unique(): simple concatenation keeps duplicates. Fix: list(dict.fromkeys(list1 + list2)).
Fix is_valid_email(): only checks '@' presence — accepts '@domain', 'user@', 'a@@b'. Fix: split('@') and check two non-empty parts.
Fix get_query_string(): split('?')[1] raises IndexError on URLs without query string. Fix: return '' when no '?' present.
Fix count_open_issues(): counts all issues instead of filtering by state='open'. Fix: use sum with state check.
Fix get_status_label(): case-sensitive dict lookup rejects 'UP', 'DOWN', 'PENDING'. Fix: normalize to lowercase before lookup.
Fix format_line_number(): ignores width — no right-justification padding. Fix: str(n).rjust(width).
Fix get_memo_tags(): reads 'tag' instead of 'tags' — always returns []. Fix: use correct key 'tags'.
Fix has_hot_reload(): reads 'hmr' instead of 'hot' — returns False even when HMR is enabled. Fix: use key 'hot'.
Fix is_detached_head(): reads 'detached' instead of 'is_detached' — always returns False. Fix: use correct key 'is_detached'.
Fix is_valid_component_id(): isalnum() rejects underscore characters. Fix: allow alphanumeric and underscore.
Fix is_body_too_large(): uses >= instead of > — rejects bodies at exactly the allowed limit. Fix: use strict greater-than.
Fix strip_auth_header(): case-sensitive check misses 'authorization', 'AUTHORIZATION'. Fix: normalize key to lowercase before comparison.
Fix is_repo_archived(): reads 'is_archive' instead of 'archived' — always returns False. Fix: use correct key 'archived'.
Fix format_duration(): uses seconds//60 (total minutes) instead of (seconds%3600)//60 (remainder). Fix: compute minutes as remainder within hour.
Fix replace_tabs(): replaces tab with a single space instead of width spaces. Fix: use ' ' * width.
Fix is_memo_public(): compares to lowercase 'public' instead of 'PUBLIC' — always returns False for public memos. Fix: compare to 'PUBLIC'.
Fix get_port(): reads 'server_port' instead of 'port' — always returns default. Fix: use correct key 'port'.
Fix abbreviate_branch(): truncates without appending '...'. Fix: slice to max_len-3 and append '...'.
Fix count_output_edges(): counts all edges instead of filtering by source node. Fix: filter edges where source == node_id.
Fix normalize_path(): unconditionally prepends '/' — creates '//path'. Fix: only prepend when path doesn't already start with '/'.
Fix is_absolute_url(): only checks 'http://' — misses 'https://' URLs. Fix: check both schemes.
Fix count_watchers(): reads 'stargazers_count' instead of 'watchers_count'. Fix: use correct key.
Fix format_uptime_percent(): divides total/up instead of up/total — gives values over 100%. Fix: swap operands.
Fix is_empty_line(): only checks '' — misses whitespace-only lines. Fix: use not line.strip().
Fix get_memo_author(): reads 'creator' instead of 'author' — always returns None. Fix: use correct key 'author'.
Fix is_dev_mode(): reads 'env' instead of 'mode' — misses configs that only set 'mode'. Fix: use key 'mode'.
Fix get_stash_count(): reads 'count' instead of 'entries' — always returns 0. Fix: use correct key 'entries'.
Fix get_node_inputs(): reads 'input' (singular) instead of 'inputs' — always returns []. Fix: use correct key 'inputs'.
Fix parse_query_int(): int(None) raises TypeError when param is absent. Fix: return default when value is None.
Fix is_timeout_error(): checks 'type' instead of 'code' — misses errors with only a 'code' field. Fix: check 'code'.
Fix get_default_branch(): reads 'default' instead of 'default_branch' — returns 'main' for repos with non-main default. Fix: use correct key.
Fix format_response_time(): divides ms by 100 instead of 1000 — 1000ms shows as '10.00s'. Fix: divide by 1000.
Fix split_into_chunks(): uses len(text)-1 as range stop — drops last chunk when len%size==1. Fix: use len(text).
Fix summarize_memo(): slices words[:max_words-1] instead of words[:max_words] — returns one fewer word. Fix: use max_words.
Fix get_base_url(): reads 'base_url' instead of 'base' — returns default for all configured bases. Fix: use correct key.
Fix is_branch_merged(): reads 'is_merged' instead of 'merged' — always returns False for merged branches. Fix: use correct key.
Fix get_node_outputs(): reads singular 'output' instead of 'outputs' — returns empty list for all nodes with outputs. Fix: use correct key.
Fix get_rate_limit(): reads 'rate' instead of 'limit' — returns default 100 for all configured limits. Fix: use correct key.
Fix get_response_data(): reads 'payload' instead of 'data' — returns None for all responses with data. Fix: use correct key.
Fix get_repo_language(): reads 'lang' instead of 'language' — returns 'Unknown' for all repos. Fix: use correct key.
Fix get_monitor_url(): reads 'endpoint' instead of 'url' — returns empty string for all monitors. Fix: use correct key.
Fix count_lines(): uses count('\n') which undercounts by 1 for text without trailing newline. Fix: use splitlines().
